article.headline: David Corenswet Transforms Into NFL Underdog John Tuggle for Mr. Irrelevant Movie
article.summary: David Corenswet stars as the last 1983 NFL draft pick John Tuggle in the upcoming biographical sports drama hitting theaters December 25, 2026.
article.body:
After flying high as Superman, David Corenswet trades his cape for a jersey to portray the unlikely journey of John Tuggle, the final player selected in the 1983 NFL draft by the New York Giants. The film showcases Tuggle's defiance of expectations both on the gridiron and in his personal life, a performance that is already generating significant buzz as potential Oscar-worthy work ahead of its release. Corenswet stars alongside Michael Shannon, who plays Giants coach Bill Parcells, and Isabel May, who portrays Tuggle's love interest, Katie. 

For football fans and cinema-goers, this true story offers an intimate look at the dedication required to defy the label of an underdog. The production highlights the intense bond between a player and a head coach, capturing the moment the New York Giants picked Tuggle in the final round—a decision that forever altered the trajectory of his professional career. According to Yahoo, the film explores how remarkable perseverance can overcome even the most daunting challenges in the sports world.

Directed by Jonathan Levine with a script by Nick Santora, the film features an ensemble cast including David Krumholtz, Tuwaine Barrett, Thaddeus LaGrone, Alexander England, Spencer House, and Tandi Wright. Produced by a large team including David Ellison and Dana Goldberg, the project has already begun promotional activities. 

Fans looking for an early look can participate in ticket giveaways through Audacy, which is offering seats for an advanced screening. This special showing is scheduled to take place at the Cinemark Egyptian Theater in Arundel Mills Mall on December 16, 2026, at 7pm. Following these promotional screenings, the full theatrical release is slated for December 25, 2026.

article.headline: Brighton Hosts Universitatea Craiova Seeking Rebound After Recent Premier League Defeat
article.summary: Brighton and Hove Albion take on Universitatea Craiova in the UEFA Conference League at the American Express Stadium on November 26.
article.body: Universitatea Craiova enters this UEFA Conference League fixture riding the momentum of a dominant 6-2 away victory against UTA Arad, a game where Stefan Baiaram scored twice. In stark contrast, Brighton and Hove Albion look to recover from a 2-0 defeat to Hull City, despite recording 70% possession and eight shots on target in that match. The Lions from Bănie arrive in England boasting an impressive form of eight wins and two draws in their last ten outings, averaging 2.7 goals per game while maintaining 53.6% possession. Meanwhile, Fabian Hurzeler’s side has maintained a solid record this season with seven wins, two losses, and one draw, bolstered by goalkeeper Bart Verbruggen’s five clean sheets across competitions. The outcome of this match carries significant weight for group standings as both clubs continue their European campaigns. Brighton’s tactical setup relies heavily on the distribution of playmakers like Charalampos Kostoulas, Ibrahim Osman, and Georginio Rutter, who each lead the team with two assists. On the other side, Alexandru Cicaldau has provided six assists in his last ten matches, fueling a potent attack led by Assad Al Hamlawi and Simon Elisor, who have each netted seven goals. Sportsgambler analysts have noted an Asian Handicap of +2.25 for the Romanian visitors, reflecting the defensive challenge expected for the underdogs at the American Express Stadium. The fixture provides a chance for Brighton to leverage their home advantage after their recent league disappointment. Kick-off is scheduled for 11:45 on Thursday, 26 November, with live commentary and match statistics provided by BBC Sport.

news.og_title: ما هي مساعي الدولة المصرية لتنظيم التنقيب عن الذهب في صحرائها؟ - يستحق الانتباه - Arabic - BBC News عربي
news.og_desc:
على امتداد الصحراء المصرية في جنوب البلاد، تنشط جماعات "الدهّابة" المنقّبين عن الذهب.

لكن هذا النشاط، الذي ظل لسنوات خارج الإطار الرسمي، تحوّل إلى ملف أمني بعد أن أطلقت السلطات المصرية حملة واسعة لمكافحة التنقيب غير المشروع وتهريب الذهب.

وبعد أشهر من المواجهة بين السلطات والمنقّبين، ظهر مسار جديد يقوم على الحوار بغية تقنين عمليات التنقيب، عبر مبادرة تهدف إلى دمج الدهّابة في المنظومة الرسمية.

لكن هذه المبادرة نفسها أثارت تساؤلات واعتراضات بشأن إدارة هذا الملف ومستقبل الذهب في جنوب مصر.

فمن هم الدهّابة في مصر؟ ولماذا انتقلت الدولة من حربهم إلى الحوار معهم؟ وما دور إبراهيم العرجاني في ذلك؟
